summary: builder-II's quality gates are real but narrow: CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml:89-96) runs ruff over everything, pytest (1,533 tests, healthy — only 4 environment-conditional skips, zero xfail), but mypy on only 5 of 159 modules and bandit with 8 blanket skips suppressing 123 findings. Empirical mypy runs on 13 authority-bearing candidates show 5 pass clean today (free CI wins) and 8 fail, but failures are concentrated and mechanical: 7 union-attr errors in one shared dependency (goose_command_proposal.py) block three HITL modules; setup_apply.py (27), verification_execution_ledger.py (44), and verification_execution_runner.py (1) have their own Optional-narrowing errors — all real potential NoneType crashes in governance paths; one missing types-PyYAML stub blocks setup_rollback_execute.py. pytest-cov is installed but completely unwired (no config, no CI flag, no baseline). The most serious single finding: hitl_command_runner.py — the subprocess executor for human-approved commands — has zero test references. Bandit's B404/B603/B607/B101/B105/B106 skips are justified for a local command-execution platform, but B110/B112 (29 silent try/except-pass sites) suppress swallowed errors inside event_ledger.py and artifact_chain_verification.py, which undermines the platform's evidence-integrity claims. Dead code is modest: agent_tui.py (1,173 lines, zero importers) and voice_policy.py (production-orphaned, kept alive by its own test).

The Optional-narrowing fixes in setup_apply.py and verification_execution_ledger.py change behavior at None boundaries (code that today would crash or silently proceed) — regressions in receipt/ledger semantics are possible; rely on tests/test_setup_apply.py and tests/test_verification_execution_ledger.py and add cases for the None paths being narrowed

Surfacing previously swallowed exceptions in event_ledger.py and artifact_chain_verification.py (B110 cleanup) may convert silent degradation into hard failures in operator flows; some sites may be intentional best-effort behavior — each site needs a judgment call, not a mechanical rewrite

A coverage floor set optimistically will flake CI: 20 of 158 modules have zero test references and TUI modules (agent_tui, hitl_tui, model_tui, profile_tui, promote_tui, postflight_tui, goose_tui) are effectively untestable without a Textual harness — start with an omit list and the measured baseline, ratchet later
